transcript.text: One thing about me, especially being a stay-at-home mom, is I love a little day out.
I'm constantly finding a reason to get out of the house with my toddler,
even if we don't have anything exciting planned.
And I never really know where the day will take us.
So of course, after packing up all the baby essentials and snacks,
I also have to make sure that there's one for me.
These Power Crunch protein bars are my current faves, especially the triple chocolate.
It has 13 grams of protein, and I love the light, crispy wafer texture.
It's sweet, crunchy, and feels more like a little treat than your typical protein bar.
First stop is coffee, of course.
Then I had a couple random errands to run in the post office,
a hair product restock, and can never miss a quick Target trip.
Also can't forget to fit in a little park time for my girl.
She was having the time of her life in this thousand degree weather.
But back in the car, and I was ready for a little afternoon pick-me-up.
Now I can get on with my day, because we still have one more stop to make.
Groceries, and then we're officially calling it a day.

transcript.text: Get ready to experience Thailand's culinary soul with our favorite Thai eats.
Crab omelets are super full of succulent crab meat wrapped in a soft, silky egg texture.
An egg and crab lovers dream.
Join the queue at Tips Hamai.
A must-try is their famous Pad Thai Sen Chan, which wraps the noodle dish in a tasty egg layer.
Chai Yan, also known as Thai iced milk tea, is made from a mix of tea leaves, spices, sugar,
and condensed and evaporated milk to create sugary, sweet deliciousness.
You can't go wrong with the traditional poached Thai chicken rice,
but we love the combination that mixes it up with half-fried chicken.
Fresh ripe mango is sliced and paired with glutinous sticky rice topped with rich coconut cream.
Tom Yum is the iconic hot and sour Thai soup.
Lots of protein is added to an extremely flavorsome broth made of Thai chilies and herbs.
Papau is ideal for seafood lovers.
An entire fish is stuffed with Thai herbs and grilled crispy over charcoal.
End your night with a sweet banana and Nutella roti.
The airy roti is stuffed with fresh bananas and fried crispy,
after which it is covered with a thick layer of Nutella and sweet condensed milk.
Did we miss any of your favorites?
Let us know in the comments!

transcript.text: Es war immer wieder so ein Tag, an dem ich richtig viel erledigen musste und dabei habe ich euch mitgenommen.
Ich habe versucht, relativ früh aufzustehen, damit ich auch wirklich alles schaffe.
Bevor es aber mit den ganzen Erledigungen losging, war ich noch zum Brunchen verabredet.
Hier habe ich natürlich mit SumUp bezahlt, das habe ich nämlich gerade neu für mich entdeckt.
Das SumUp-Konto ist nämlich ein kostenloses All-in-One-Konto, mit dem man seine alltäglichen Finanzen verwalten kann.
Zum Beispiel kann man ganz detailliert seine Ausgaben sehen, die werden in so Kategorien eingeteilt und das ist einfach super übersichtlich.
Und man kann auch Spaces mit eigenen Sparzielen erstellen, das ist super praktisch für zum Beispiel Reisen.
Aber was ich fast am coolsten finde, ist die Cashback-Funktion.
Das SumUp-Konto kommt nämlich bei fast jedem Einkauf bis zu 5% Cashback, bei Partnergeschäften 5%, im Supermarkt 2% und 0,5% auf alle anderen Ausgaben.
Deswegen checkt auf jeden Fall mal das SumUp-Konto ab.
Ich finde es super praktisch für den Alltag.
Ich bin dann nochmal in mein Lieblingscafé gefahren, habe meine Kaffeebunden geholt und war dann noch im Supermarkt einkaufen.
Das war es auch schon mit meinen Erledigungen.

500+ mad tasty high protein recipes on my page ❤️

Recipe (35g P, 465 Cals) ⬇️

Ingredients - 
	•	2 slices double protein bread 
	•	30g low-fat paneer (milky mist)
	•	80g Greek yogurt (epigamia)
	•	¼ cup besan
	•	½ cube cheese (grated)
	•	Handful spinach, finely chopped
	•	small onion sliced
	•	1 tsp Schezwan chutney
	•	¼ tsp turmeric powder
	•	Chilli flakes, to taste
	•	Mixed herbs, to taste
	•	Salt & pepper, to taste
	•	1/4th cup water (to adjust batter)
	•	Oil spray (for cooking)

⸻

Method

1️⃣ Prepare the batter
In a bowl mix besan, Greek yogurt, chopped onion, spinach, turmeric, chilli flakes, mixed herbs, salt, pepper and water to form a thick batter.

2️⃣ Dip the bread
Dip both slices of bread into the batter so they are coated well.

3️⃣ Cook the toast
Heat a pan, spray a little oil and cook the coated bread on both sides until golden and slightly crisp.

4️⃣ Add the protein topping
Spread the crumbled paneer over the toast and cook that side until its toasted and then sprinkle the grated cheese on top.

5️⃣ Melt the cheese
Cover the pan and cook for 2 minutes until the cheese melts.

6️⃣ Final touch
Drizzle Schezwan chutney on top, slice and serve hot.

✅Should I do savory or sweet breakfast recipe next? 
Tell meee➡️

F*CK or SUCK
High Protein Chicken Pizza Wrap

I liked this idea so I made a few changes to give it a whopping 75g protein!

👨‍🍳 Ingredients, makes 1 serve

✅ Shredded Chicken, 150g / 5.3 oz
✅ Light Mozzarella, 80g / 2.8 oz
✅ Large Egg, 1
✅ Egg Whites, 100g / 3.5 oz
✅ Tomato Paste, 10g / 0.35 oz
✅ Spring Onions, sliced, to taste
✅ Low Carb High Protein Wrap, 1
✅ Salt and Pepper, optional

👉 Method

1. Heat a pan over medium heat and lightly spray with oil.
2. Spread the shredded chicken evenly over the pan.
3. Sprinkle the mozzarella over the chicken.
4. Whisk together the egg and egg whites, then pour evenly over the top.
5. Add your spring onions.
6. Spread the tomato paste over one side of the wrap.
7. Place the wrap tomato paste side down on top and gently press it down.
8. Cook until the egg mixture has set and everything holds together.
9. Flip the whole thing over and cook the wrap side until golden and crispy.
10. Fold in half and enjoy!

📊 Calories and Macros, whole recipe
600 kcal | P: 75g | C: 25g | F: 20g

Macros will vary depending on the wrap and mozzarella used.

corpus.caption:
Cozy Cottage Pie Recipe (High Protein)
____
Meat Filling:

To a large pan over medium heat, add 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil and 2 medium chalets (diced, finely). Once the onion starts to look translucent, add in 2 garlic cloves (minced). Stir together and then add in 1.5 lb lean ground beef, breaking it up into small pieces with your wooden spoon or spatula.

Still on medium heat, season the meat with:
- 1 tbsp smoked paprika
- 1 tbsp garlic powder
- 1 tbsp oregano or Italian seasoning
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 tsp red chilli flakes
- 1 tsp dried thyme
- 1/2 tsp dried rosemary

Stir until well combined. Then, add in 1 tsp worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp flour and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Stir until fully incorporated and then add in 1 cup beef or bone broth. Add in 1/2 cup frozen peas, 1/2 cup frozen corn and 2 carrots (diced). Stir until everything is well combined and bring the heat down to a simmer. Let the filling simmer for 5-8mins, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens slightly. Remove from the heat and set aside.

Mashed Potoates
Peel and chop 2lbs of russet potatoes into evenly sized chunks. Add the potatoes to a large pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are fork-tender.

Drain the potatoes and return them to the pot. Mash them with a mallet or potatoe masher. Then, add:

- 1/2 cup plain skyr
- tbsp butter
- 1 tsp garlic powder
- 1/4 cup milk
- 1/4 cup grated Parmesan
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper

Mash everything together until smooth and creamy.

Assemble and Bake:
Preheat your oven to 350°F

Lightly grease a 9x13inch baking dish. Pour your meat, filling into the dish and spread it out evenly. Spoon your mashed potatoes on top, smoothing them into an even layer with a spatula. Use a fork to create some texture on the surface. Sprinkle some grated Parmesan on top.

Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the filling is bubbling around the edges. If the top is not yet golden brown or crispy, let it broil for 1-2mins (keeping an eye on it continuously to make sure it doesn’t burn) or until the top begins to brown.

Remove from the oven and let it rest for 5-10 minutes.

corpus.caption: Chili garlic shrimp a perfect garlic shrimp dinner . it’s spicy and delicious . a great high protein meal. Serve over rice or with some pasta!  If you like my recipes and would you like to support me click  http://buymeacoffee.com/cookwithchn 1. 16 oz shrimp cleaned deveined  2. 1 tablespoons olive oil  3. 2 tablespoons butter  4. 8-10 garlic minced  5. 1 teaspoon or more chili flakes  6. 1.5 teaspoon paprika  7. 2-3 tablespoons cilantro chopped  8. 2 tablespoons water  9. 1 teaspoon salt  10. 1 tablespoon sriracha sauce  11. Optional- squeeze of lemon/lime juice  1. Thaw shrimp, cut a slit down the back to butterfly and pat dry with a napkin 2. Chop your garlic and cilantro 3. On medium heat to a skillet, add olive oil and butter 4. Turn down the heat and add in the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds without burning 5.  sprinkle in the chili flakes, paprika, and cilantro 6. Give it a mix and then add a little bit of water to create a sauce 7. Drop in the shrimp . Increase heat to medium  8. Season shrimp with salt and give it a good mix 9. Drizzle on the Sriracha sauce and a squeeze of lime or lemon juice and mix gently 10. Cook for another 1 to 2 minutes to ensure that the shrimp has cooked and then immediately removed from the heat so that you do not cook away the sauce 11. Serve as is or with rice / pasta  #food #recipes #seafood #healthy #good

brief.headline: 30–60s videos deliver a 7.19× median view/follower lift — the single biggest lever in protein coffee.
moves: Shoot your next protein coffee video between 30–60 seconds: that format has a 7.19× lift (n=24) and makes up 59% of the top quartile vs 9% of the bottom.
Write a long caption (4.17× lift, n=35) and add 5+ hashtags (2.06× lift, n=21) — long captions appear in 59% of top-quartile videos vs 23% of bottom, and 5+ hashtags in 27% of top vs 5% of bottom.
Use licensed music (5.74× lift, n=7) and layer text-heavy on-screen elements (3.37× lift, n=59) with a text hook in the first 3 seconds (2.11× lift, n=72).
brief.avoid: Stop posting 60s+ videos — they have a 0.16× lift (n=46), and original audio is even worse at 0.17× (n=82).
